item.title: 3 Hunting Towers Destroyed (South Germany)
item.description: Received anonymously: 3 hunting towers tired. 3 hunting towers asleep!

item.title: 50 Chickens Liberated from Koporos Slaughter in Brooklyn (New York, USA)
item.description: Received anonymously: 50 chickens liberated under the cover of the night, hours before being slaughtered during the ritual of Kaporos that takes place in the streets of Brooklyn every year. Be the resistance, go out, liberate animals, fight back!

item.title: 3 Activists Murdered in India for Opposing Cow Slaughter
item.description: Lalit Jain was an advocate and associated with Bajrang Dal, the youth wing of the Vishva Hindu Parishad. Jain was an activist against State illegal cow slaughter, he was on his way to attend proceedings related to a case about illegal cow slaughter. He was waylaid by assailants in an auto rickshaw, three rounds were fired at him … Continue reading

item.title: The Guide: What is Direct Action and How Do I Get Started
item.description: (aka How Do I Join the Animal Liberation Front) by Anonymous (with special emphasis on the liberation of fur-bearing animals) Activists and sympathizers frequently ask how they might go about joining the Animal Liberation Front (ALF), a clandestine group that utilizes illegal direct action to fight the oppression of non-human animals. item.title: 2 Hens Rescued From Abandoned Mink Farm, in Solidarity With Zoe Rosenberg (USA)
item.description: Received anonymously: Two weeks ago, we visited one of the mink farms at a location not mentioned here for security reasons. item.title: ALF Liberates 6 Chickens, Destroys Hunting Stand (Germany)
item.description: Received anonymously: Hell on Earth — 6 chickens freed from so‑called parent‑stock housing! In the cold evening hours of 09.11.25 we helped 6 individuals break out of the fate imposed on them by humans — on their way to a future that finally belongs to them. item.title: Rich Valley Furs Re-opens on former Lion Farms site (Ohio, USA)
item.description: Rich Valley Furs has officially opened on the former Lion Farms property in Ohio (2707 Hoaglin Rd, Van Wert, OH 45891), bringing mink farming back to the area following the previous facility’s closure. Much of the experienced management team is staying on, providing stability and day-to-day expertise. The new owners plan to modernize operations with … Continue reading

item.title: Gengel Mink Farm in Lake Villa, Illinois Has Closed (USA)
item.description: After 65 years in operation, and the slaughter of too many mink to count, we can confirm that the Gengel Mink Farm in Lake Villa, Illinois has closed. Ron Gengel was an important figure in the mink industry, serving as president of Fur Commission USA for many years. Ron and his son Gerry also owned … Continue reading
